title.en: Welcome to the new Hemisphere Launcher

body.en:
One click and you're on Hemisphere: Minecraft, Fabric, Java and our performance mods are installed and kept up to date for you.

Pick your optional mods in the Mods tab, and use Settings → Installation → Repair if anything ever goes wrong.
Mod Menu adds a Mods button in game with a searchable list of every installed mod and their settings.
The server restarts every day for a few minutes. The launcher shows a countdown in your own time zone.
